about: Reasons a live run may produce nothing and still be a correct run (graded GOOD, sub idle) when its own receipt STATES the reason (empty_reason / skip_reason / no_op_reason, top level or summary). Read by scripts/lib/run_quality.py. A zero-output run with no stated reason, or a reason not listed here, stays EMPTY. An idle run with a stale or implausible input is DEGRADED. Tokens follow the expected_output closed enum in scripts/check_n8n_workflow_framework.py; deferred_to_batch, credit_cap_reached and data_blocked are deliberately not idle.

reasons.not_trading_day: it was not a trading day
reasons.window_not_reached: its window had not opened yet
reasons.no_due_threads: no thread was due for a check
